verdict.rationale: Khoj documents official web and desktop apps, plus Obsidian, Emacs and WhatsApp clients (khoj-docs-4, khoj-docs-34). Several of these go beyond basic chat: the desktop app syncs files and folders and can install as a PWA (khoj-docs-18, khoj-docs-49), voice chat works on web, Desktop and Obsidian (khoj-docs-56), and WhatsApp supports slash commands such as /online and /dream (khoj-docs-16, khoj-docs-58). Users independently praise the Obsidian client (khoj-comm-1). missing for 10: a dedicated native mobile app (only WhatsApp is evidenced), an explicit feature-parity matrix across surfaces, and hands-on corroboration of the web and desktop apps.
